svg.text: Two cubes — a 2-cube and a 3-cube — spinning on top of each other
cyan 2-cube: base-2 Hilbert on all six faces (4³ cells) · magenta 3-cube: base-3 Peano on all six faces (9² cells)
genuine 3-D Rodrigues spin (different axes, opposite senses, 1:2 rates) · sliding across one another · screen-blended interference
2⁶ and 3⁴ face cells are coprime — the overlaid curves never resynchronise (cube_face_counts_coprime); 2⁶·3⁴ ∣ |M|
